name: Namo Saraswati Vignan Sadhana Yojana
benefit: - **Class 11th Benefit:** ₹10,000/- per annum, paid as a monthly stipend of ₹1,000/- for 10 months. - **Class 12th Benefit:** ₹15,000/- per annum. Students will receive a monthly stipend of ₹1,000/- for 10 months (₹10,000) - **Additional Benefit:** ₹5,000/- after passing the Class 12th board examination.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a student. - The applicant must have studied in a government or grant-in-aid school in Class 9th and 10th. - The applicant must have scored 50% or more in the Class 10 board examination. - The applicant must have taken admission in the science stream in a government, grant-in-aid, or self-financed school recognized by GSHSEB (Gujarat Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Board) or CBSE (Central Board of Secondary Education). - If the applicant has studied in a recognized self-financed school for Class 9 and/or 10, the family’s annual income must be ₹6,00,000/- or less.
